summary: Telecom Argentina S.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a procedural extension of the antitrust review period by Argentina's Antitrust Tribunal. The Tribunal extended the original 45-day period under Law 27,442 by 30 additional days, effective after the initial period that began February 24, 2026. No specific transaction, price, or parties are named, only a reference to a prior material event on August 5, 2025. The filing is a routine regulatory update with no substantive deal terms or special-situation catalyst. Watch for any subsequent announcement of the underlying transaction or merger outcome.
